name: Sora Fujimoto
source:
Sora is one of Ryo's roommates in the F dorms. She is an energetic futanari with a strong libido. Sora looks very similar to the main character, Ryo. They both have freckles, they both have orange hair, they both have a hair antenna. All of these similarities has made some other characters confused on whether they are related or not. With that said though, there are differences, mainly that Sora is futanari. Other differences would include the fact that Sora is very athletic and tanned. 

Sora is a pretty forward character going for whatever or whoever she likes without hesitation. She pushes the boundaries and teases a lot. She is also very smug. 

Sora works has a lifeguard at the beach of Wimblewick on weekdays, she is also spends a lot of her free time there on weekends. Sora is also part of both the athletics club and the volleyball club.
